ddi_semantics.meaning_of_1: an interaction is recorded between the two ATC level-4 classes in the bundle's DDI source
ddi_semantics.meaning_of_0: NOT DETERMINABLE from the bundle: could be 'no interaction recorded', 'not assessed' or 'not in source'. Treated as 'no record'.
ddi_semantics.level_of_assertion: class (ATC level-4) level; bundle does not document how molecule-level data were aggregated to class level

safe_use_rule: absence of a recorded interaction must never be displayed as 'no interaction' or 'safe'
